title: Synthetic conformance fixtures (labelled SYNTHETIC) + conformance test suite in CI
context: Ewing Registry Standards produces an OPEN, CONSENT-FIRST registry STANDARD (common data elements, governance, interoperability profiles) for Ewing Sarcoma. It is NOT a data store and Elyos never holds patient data. Fully synthetic, clearly labelled conformance fixtures plus a CI conformance suite exercise the schema and validator with intentional pass and fail cases; a CI synthetic-check rejects any unlabelled fixture (depends on jsonschema-050, validator-051). Binding guardrails apply: open/aggregate/de-identified only, NO real patient data anywhere (fixtures synthetic), per-source license verification (bind terminologies by reference, never redistribute), no medical advice, and provenance on every assertion. No partner or expert reviewers are secured yet, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Author fully synthetic, labelled conformance fixtures and a CI conformance test suite with pass and fail cases.
acceptanceCriteria: All fixtures fully synthetic and labelled `SYNTHETIC - NOT REAL`
CI synthetic-check rejects any unlabelled fixture
Suite includes intentional pass and fail cases
